verdict.rationale: BVNK's Receive product docs describe accepting stablecoin payments. Each payment gets a live quote and a unique blockchain address, or a reusable channel address. Settlement is confirmed through registrable HTTP webhooks for pay-ins, on-chain confirmed channel transactions and late transactions, and pay-ins can be simulated in sandbox. Missing for 10: the specific create-payment API endpoint and request schema are not cited, a hosted checkout page or flow is not documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can accept a stablecoin payment from a customer through a documented checkout or payment API — create the payment, present the address or flow, and confirm settlement programmatically

citations.quote: For every payment, BVNK generates a live quote to be accepted by the customer and a unique blockchain address for the payment to be made to.

Using BVNKs Receive products, you can collect crypto payments from your customers, allowing them to top up accounts or purchase goods and services from you whilst BVNK manages the conversion and settlement to your accounts.
A channel is a unique, repeated-use blockchain address that can receive crypto or stablecoins at any time.
When something happens in your BVNK account, such as a pay-in or a payout, the platform sends an HTTP POST request to a URL you provide with the event details in real time.
triggered when a new channel transaction is confirmed on chain, and the transaction has been processed.
